product.name: atlas-studio-alan-vo
product.brief: Local AI job application framework: import postings, score relevance against a target role profile using deterministic TF-IDF cosine similarity, and track the lifecycle with correct fetch-failure handling.

features.title: Posting import, relevance scoring and lifecycle tracking
features.description: Import job postings, run deterministic TF-IDF relevance scoring against a target role profile, attempt content fetch, and track the correct lifecycle (new -> scored, fetch_failed retryable, expired terminal). Addresses issue #534: a failed fetch is never conflated with an expired posting.
acceptance: POST /api/postings imports a posting with status 'new'
POST /api/scoring/run scores all 'new' and retryable 'fetch_failed' postings
A posting whose fetch fails is marked fetch_failed with an incremented retry count, not expired
A posting whose fetch succeeds is marked scored with a 0-1 relevance score
A posting whose deadline passed is marked expired (terminal)
fetch_failed entries with retry_count below the cap are re-selected as candidates
GET /api/postings lists postings with filtering by status and pagination
GET /api/postings/{id} shows full detail including scores and fetch metadata

features.title: Scorer evaluation against labeled dataset
features.description: Evaluate the TF-IDF scorer against a small labeled dataset of job postings with explicit IR metrics (Precision@k, MAP, NDCG) and a limitations discussion.
acceptance: GET /api/scoring/evaluate returns metrics computed from a labeled fixture
Metrics include Precision@k, MAP, and NDCG
Results are reproducible (deterministic algorithm)

features.title: Opt-in LLM explanations for scoring
features.description: Advisory LLM explanation of why a posting matched the target profile, grounded in TF-IDF feature overlap. Supports OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama via httpx adapters. Returns a clear 501 without LLM_API_KEY and never fabricates responses.
acceptance: POST /api/scoring/explain generates a grounded, labeled advisory explanation
Provider errors are surfaced clearly, never fabricated success

features.title: OIDC authorization-code login via Keycloak with SAML brokering
features.description: Full OIDC authorization-code login through Keycloak using state+nonce+PKCE with signature/issuer/audience validated tokens. Local-only demo mode binds localhost and refuses startup in production.
acceptance: Demo mode login works on localhost only, refuses in production
role-based authorization on all data endpoints
unauthenticated requests rejected, role denial enforced
OIDC callback validates state, nonce, PKCE and token claims

features.title: Application outcome tracking
features.description: Record when a user applies to a posting and track outcomes (applied, interviewed, offer, rejected, withdrawn).
acceptance: POST /api/applications records an application against a posting
PATCH /api/applications/{id} updates the outcome
GET /api/applications lists applications with filtering

features.title: CV/resume tailoring to a posting
features.description: Generate a tailored CV/resume bullet list for a specific posting using NLP keyword overlap analysis, opt-in LLM enhancement.
acceptance: POST /api/cv/tailor analyzes a posting against a base CV and returns keyword gaps
Opt-in LLM enhancement generates natural-language bullets
